headline: GTA 6 countdown: 10 days to go
title: GTA 6 Countdown 10 Days Left | Vice City | Vice City Is Back
video_script: Only 10 days until GTA 6. GTA 6 takes us back to Vice City, a Miami-inspired city in the fictional state of Leonida. Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Are you playing it on day one? Comment below!
joke: Pack your sunglasses, Vice City is going to be bright.
description: GTA 6 countdown - 10 days to go. GTA 6 takes us back to Vice City, a Miami-inspired city in the fictional state of Leonida. Grand Theft Auto VI launches on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Facts from Rockstar's announcements as summarised on Wikipedia.
